Community Library Notice
The library will close at 4 p.m. on Friday for a staff workshop. Normal opening hours resume on Saturday. Books may be returned through the outdoor return box at any time.
questions.prompt: What can visitors do after the library closes on Friday?

stemBlocks.text: Your professor is teaching a class on community planning. Respond to the question and explain your opinion.

turns.speaker: Professor Lee
turns.text: A town can fund one new project: a public garden or a small community library. Which would you support, and why?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I would support the garden. People of different ages could work together and learn about growing food.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I prefer the library. It would offer books, quiet study space, and activities throughout the year.
